name.en: CM-PharmE G3-2d native relation review overlay

description.en: Native-only overlay: hasStrength Characterization and its end cardinalities; three G3-2a mediations retained.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep EnterpriseCapability as a Mode dependent on exactly one Organization. Preserve the current Mode-to-bearer property and add a bearer-to-Mode Characterization only after confirming inverse semantics; do not require every Organization to have a capability. Negative acceptance: One intrinsic Mode cannot inhere in two distinct Organizations.

Common derived Mode-to-bearer query surface over typed Organization/Facility Characterization routes. Native exact-one-across-routes is documented in p4a-capacity-xor-note and enforced in OWL DL/SHACL; a broad-only ABox assertion is not admitted.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep RegulatoryJurisdiction as a formal legal-scope reference of the contextual assignment. Do not type direct Relator-to-rigid-Kind Mediation; introduce a role only if dependence is evidenced. Negative acceptance: Classification in J1 does not transfer to J2.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Retain a typed scheme-and-version reference. Do not merge equal lexical codes across schemes or impose an exactly-one-scheme axiom until the entry identity criterion is agreed. Negative acceptance: Equal code strings across schemes do not identify one entry.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep the broad parent property. Add a Product-specific child for evidenced M016 mappings and a Presentation-specific child only when a source explicitly supports it. Negative acceptance: Do not infer that a presentation using the parent relation is a MedicinalProduct; these Kinds are disjoint.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep a formal reference to DosageFormSpecification. Defer global minimum and maximum cardinalities until Presentation identity and source completeness are evaluated. Negative acceptance: A generic Product dosage label does not identify this Presentation's form.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Treat MatchConfidence as a Quality dependent on one EntityMatchAssertion, but hold class-wide Characterization and the minimum-one constraint until unscored assertions are resolved. Record this as an open conformance blocker. Negative acceptance: One Quality individual cannot belong to two distinct Assertions.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep a reference to PackageConfiguration as a specification. Do not use componentOf or a universal existence constraint until identity and completeness are established. Negative acceptance: A pack-size value is insufficient to identify a configuration.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep presentationOf as a formal Presentation-to-Product association. Examine the one-Product identity condition in the candidate, but defer a universal OWL cardinality until author review. Negative acceptance: A Product source row alone does not instantiate a Presentation.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Create shortagePresentation only when a source identifies the exact Presentation, period and jurisdiction. Do not derive it from a Product-only report. Negative acceptance: Product-only report does not identify a package/presentation.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Record shortageProduct only with an identified Product and report scope; do not infer shortages for all of its Presentations. Negative acceptance: Presentation shortage does not establish shortage of all presentations.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep withinCountry as a versioned formal spatial or administrative reference; prohibit self-containment and limit an exactly-one-Country constraint to proven data scope. Negative acceptance: Country cannot be within itself; Jurisdiction is distinct.

G3-2e-E bounded author decision: Keep a versioned formal administrative or spatial reference; reject self-containment and postal-label inference, and scope any exactly-one-Region rule to complete sources. Negative acceptance: Region cannot be within itself or inferred from postal label.

text.en: RR-01: Operating organization Role; one or more operators.
RR-02: Operated facility Role; exactly one facility per operation relation.
RR-03: Separate registered Organization and Facility Roles.
RR-04: Separate classified Product and Substance Roles.
RR-05: Applied entry Role is a relatum; revise W4 reference wording.
RR-06: Scoped listing requires presentation and documented responsible party.
RR-07: Supported Assertion Role; support never implies truth.
RR-08: Used scheme Role is a relatum; lexical value remains a literal.
RR-09: Reference and alternative are context-local product roles.
RR-10: Dependent is an admitted endurant; events excluded from this RoleMixin.
RR-11: Provider is Organization, Facility or Product; no required Org-Facility pair.
RR-12: At least two distinct partner organizations; repeated independent agreements permitted.
RR-13: Record evidence is a specialization of generic evidence; no double counting.
RR-14: Contextual classification reuses Product/Substance pattern.
RR-15: Contextual entry link subsets the generic assignment pattern.
S-01: Identified bearer and used scheme, lexical value, provenance and validity.
S-02: Separate governed roles and authority; activity scope stays a reported target.
S-03: EvidenceItem has distinct SourceRecord and ObservationResult identities.
S-04: Defer AssetAtRisk and dependent Vulnerability bearer pattern; preserve declarations outside active import.
S-05: Defer ClinicalCareParticipant until admitted bearer and care-activity pattern.
S-06: Strict directed geographic containment: no self-loop or cycle; no universal transitivity axiom added.
S-07: Distinct values within one assignment; roles may overlap across assignments.

Candidate implementation authorized by the user request to continue, 2026-10-07 Asia/Tehran. Final scientific sign-off pending. Funding is institutional-only; product responsibility has two overlapping routes. Temporal admission and evidence provenance are separate from OWL structural dependence.

description.en: Scoped Product-to-PharmaceuticalSubstance association supported by bounded M016 primary_substance_id mapping. Intended child of broad hasActiveSubstance for OWL alignment in G3-2e-F; this native relation alone does not encode subproperty inheritance or mandatory composition. No Presentation domain is inferred.
Product participation is not made universally mandatory under incomplete source data.
Multiple active substances remain possible; the M016 primary-substance hook does not establish global maximum one.

text.en: 13 bounded scientific recommendations approved. This native overlay adds only a scoped Product–Substance route and single-bearer cardinalities for EnterpriseCapability and MatchConfidence. Direct Characterization of all Organization/Facility is deferred because it would require every bearer to exemplify the feature. SupplyCapacity requires two typed bearer routes and exactly-one-of-two validation before the generic null end can be eliminated. Broad parent active-substance relation and product-specific child have no native subproperty entailment yet; G3-2e-F must align OWL/SHACL. All 14 isolate proposals remain unapproved. Official OntoUML anti-pattern validation is pending.

description.en: Primary bearer-to-Mode Characterization; each Mode may have at most one Organization bearer in this branch.
Primary bearer-to-Mode Characterization; each Mode may have at most one Facility bearer in this branch.
Derived inverse query view of organizationHasSupplyCapacity; do not independently assert in admitted RDF.
Derived inverse query view of facilityHasSupplyCapacity; do not independently assert in admitted RDF.

text.en: SupplyCapacity is an intrinsic Mode. Each Mode inheres in exactly one bearer, either an Organization via organizationHasSupplyCapacity or a Facility via facilityHasSupplyCapacity, never both. Both bearer-to-Mode associations are Characterization. The inverse routes and capacityBearer are derived query views; native per-route bounds 0..1 do not themselves express the XOR. OWL exact-one on common property plus typed existential union and SHACL explicit inverse-path XOR enforce the combined policy. No Organization/Facility must possess capacity; SupplyCapacityObservationResult is an independent observation.
